ns2:section.sectionText: Fundamentals of pressurized thermal shock analysis (PTS); relevance of PTS in nuclear vessels safety assessment. Transient and steady thermal analysis. Thermal strain and thermal stress in structures. Structural behaviour of prssurized and thermally loaded cylinders. Basic linear elastic frature mechanics (LEFM). Definition of stress intensity factors. The superposition principle in LEFM and the weight function method. Crack instability and crack arrest. Numerical simulation of a PTS phenomenon in a realistic accident scenario.
